Privacy and device storage

This website

This is a static information and study site. It has no account, inquiry form, advertising or analytics script. Example controls stay in the page and are not sent to a server. GitHub Pages may process network information needed to serve the site.

App study data

The app in preparation uses included learning material and on-device study records. Study records, bookmarks and A/B examples stay on the device; there is no study backend or account synchronization. Store payments and OS notification permissions are handled by the platform.

External links and email

External standards documents and email apps apply their own provider policies. An email address and inquiry sent to support are used to respond to that inquiry.
